_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco optical networking, 14 Sep 2026: ONS 15454 MSTP / NCS 2000, ONS 15216 / 15200 DWDM passives, NCS 1000, NCS 4000, Routed Optical Networking, and optical cabling. The NCS 1000 In-Line Amplifier and OLT rows filed under the ONS 15454 label are NCS 1010 parts by SKU. No role axis.

series.series: ONS 15454 MSTP (M2 / M6 / M12 shelves and cards)
ONS 15216 filters, OADM, mux/demux and DCU
CWDM mux/demux, OADM plug-ins and chassis (CWDM-MUX / CWDM-OADM / DS-CWDM)
series.note: the home of the 28 passive CWDM mux/demux, OADM plug-ins and the 2-slot chassis planned in from transceiver (18 in the kind layer, 10 CWDM-OADM1 / OADM4 in layers round 3, 14 Sep 2026). The MDS CWDM SFP optics (DS-CWDM-1470=, DS-CWDM8G1610=) are transceivers and are not matched. ^EWDM- (layers round 3, 15 Sep 2026): EWDM-OADM2= / EWDM-OADM4= and the EWDM-OA= amplifier, planned in from interfaces-modules (kind layer, 13 Sep) — Cisco's EoL notice sells the EWDM OADMs with the CWDM Mux/Demux ('End-of-Sale … Infiniband Cables, CWDM Mux/Demux, EWDM OADM'); their exact series is the optical round's
